requirements.note: Dedicated rdma-responder-accept thread runs run_accept_loop.
Ephemeral bind (htons(0)), rdma_listen, rdma_get_src_port; AlreadyInitialized guarded at lib.rs:268.
Explicit set_bind_ip else first_active_rdma_ipv4() auto-detect. CERTUS_RDMA_BIND_IP wiring is in the mainline, out of this crate.
Returns bound {ip,port}; NotInitialized before init.
epoll over {cm fd, cmd eventfd, stop eventfd}; SPSC command inbox bridged to cmd_eventfd.
Reads private_data, keys table by PeerId, accepts, emits ConnectionEstablished{Some}.
Absent/malformed private_data -> unidentified side-list, Established(None); reclaimed only via shutdown/teardown_all.
Active->Draining->Dead; connect refused while Draining (transient in single-threaded loop; refusal exercised via force_state test).
QP->ERROR ordered before ack and asserted; but spec requires best-effort rdma_destroy_qp failure be logged, and Drop ignores return values and logs nothing.
No data path; responder is registrar/connection-manager only.
Whole-pool ibv_reg_mr, local_region, dereg-before-PD-free all present, but ibv_reg_mr failure is mapped to Bind (map_err(...::Bind)) instead of the spec-mandated Registration.
Single-client channel; second open_control_channel -> ChannelClosed.
send_event uses blocking tx.send (backpressure, never drop); lossless-under-backpressure test present.
set_actor_cpu stored pre-init; thread pins via set_thread_affinity (best-effort).
signal_stop exits without join; shutdown stops+joins, teardown_all tears down connections, idempotent via state.take().
Diagnostics route through optional ILogger and missing logger is not an error, but the async-event diagnostic path logs via eprintln! directly, bypassing ILogger.
Unit tests cover lifecycle, NotInitialized/AlreadyInitialized/ChannelClosed, and the state machine.

Feature-gated ZST no-op telemetry present and wired for accepted/identified/unidentified/teardowns, but record_accept_loop_error is never called and ResponderEvent::Error is never emitted, so the accept-loop-errors metric is never recorded.
NotInitialized-before-init tested; non-placeholder ephemeral port asserted only in the #[ignore] hardware loopback test (mock uses port 0).
Exactly one ack; QP->ERROR ordered strictly before ack.
Structural: command serviced on event-driven wake with no pending connect and no poll cycle.
Distinct-ephemeral-port check in #[ignore] hardware test; mock test only asserts independent IPs (both port 0).
Known UUID -> Some(peer); empty private_data -> None.
Criterion benchmark drives accept/disconnect over the seam; two-baseline on/off workflow documented. Actual <5% is a runtime measurement, not asserted in code.

unspecced.item: Device async-event instrumentation (TAG_ASYNC epoll wiring, drain_async_events/async_event_name, responder_async_fd/responder_drain_async_event shims)
unspecced.note: Logs QP_FATAL/QP_REQ_ERR/etc. No FR mentions async-event diagnostics.

unspecced.item: MR access widened beyond REMOTE_WRITE (LOCAL_WRITE | REMOTE_WRITE | REMOTE_READ)
unspecced.note: FR-010 specifies only REMOTE_WRITE; REMOTE_READ grants peers one-sided read of the pool with no requirement calling for it.

conflicts.note: Interface trait doc for set_bind_ip states 'The responder never auto-detects the address' and that initialize fails Bind if no IP supplied (pre-clarification behavior), contradicting the current spec FR-002a auto-detect which the implementation actually follows. Stale interface doc.
